signals.title: Polymatech Opens Singapore Hub for LED Packaging and Memory Module Assembly
signals.snippet: SINGAPORE – Polymatech has opened a new advanced electronics manufacturing facility in Singapore that will serve as its Asia-Pacific hub for LED chip-on-board (CoB) packaging and advanced memory module assembly.

signals.title: Jabil Raises Fiscal 2026 Outlook on Strong AI Infrastructure Demand

signals.title: SigmaTron Names Jim Kircher CEO
signals.snippet: ELK GROVE VILLAGE, IL -- SigmaTron International has appointed Jim Kircher chief executive officer, effective May 11, as the electronics manufacturing services provider looks to accelerate growth under its new ownership structure.

signals.title: Incap Pennsylvania Facility Temporarily Closed Following Storm-Related Power Outage
signals.snippet: HELSINKI -- Incap's electronics manufacturing facility in Pennsylvania has temporarily suspended operations following a power outage caused by severe storms in the region.

signals.title: Global Semiconductor Sales Jump 94% Year-Over-Year in April
signals.snippet: WASHINGTON, DC -- Global semiconductor sales reached $110.5 billion in April, rising 11% from March and 93.9% from the same month a year ago, according to the Semiconductor Industry Association (SIA).

signals.title: Global Semiconductor Equipment Billings Rise 14% in First Quarter
signals.snippet: MILPITAS, CA -- Global semiconductor equipment billings reached a record $36.5 billion in the first quarter, up 14% year-over-year and 1% sequentially, according to SEMI's Worldwide Semiconductor Equipment Market Statistics (WWSEMS) report.

signals.title: SEMI Report Forecasts Rapid Growth for Glass Core Substrate Market Through 2040
signals.snippet: MILPITAS, CA -- SEMI and Global Net have released a new report examining the emerging market for glass core substrates, a packaging technology being evaluated for future semiconductor applications as artificial intelligence and high-performance computing drive demand for larger and more complex packages.

signals.title: Praesidian Capital Exits Investment in Green Circuits
signals.snippet: OKLAHOMA CITY -- Praesidian Capital announced the realization and exit of its investment in Green Circuits in connection with the sale of the electronics manufacturing services provider.

signals.title: North American EMS Book-to-Bill Ratio Reaches 1.36 in April
signals.snippet: WASHINGTON, DC -- The Global Electronics Association reported continued strength in the North American electronics manufacturing services (EMS) market in April, with the industry’s book-to-bill ratio reaching 1.36.

signals.title: Semiconductors Account for 95% of AI Server Rack Value
signals.snippet: WASHINGTON, DC -- Semiconductors account for more than 95% of the content value in a leading AI server rack and represent more than half of the capital expenditures required to build and operate AI data centers, according to a new report released by the Semiconductor Industry Association (SIA) and Deloitte.

signals.title: North American PCB Bookings Jumped 25% in April
signals.snippet: BANNOCKBURN, IL – North American printed circuit board bookings surged in April as shipments also increased, pushing the industry’s book-to-bill ratio to its highest level in more than a year.
